name: MacMix 2.1.1
body:
### What’s New
- Added **global Mix shortcuts**:
Hold your chosen modifier key and a number from 1–9, then use the system volume keys to adjust or mute the corresponding app.

name: MacMix 2.1
body:
### What's new
MacMix 2.1 introduces **Scene Presets**—save your favorite audio setups and quickly switch between work, music, gaming, and more.

- **Save your audio setup:** Capture input and output devices, volume levels, per-app mixing, and supported noise control and Spatial Audio modes.
- **Make each scene your own:** Create up to 9 presets with custom names, icons, and colors.
- **Switch quickly:** Activate scenes from the Scenes page, menu bar panel, or global keyboard shortcuts. Optionally launch the apps included in each scene.

name: MacMix 2.0.2
body:
### Fixed

name: MacMix 2.0.1
body:
### Introducing MacMix Studio!

Unlock more ways to personalize and control your Mac’s audio experience:

- Custom themes and appearance
- Now Playing controls in the panel
- Pro Bluetooth controls including battery status, listening modes and Spatial Audio
- App blacklist for excluding selected apps from mixing

### What's new

- Added taking over system volume controls.

name: MacMix 1.7
body:
### What’s New

- Added support for macOS 14.4 and later.
- Improved multi-app audio mixing reliability.
- Fixed brief mixing interruptions when a mixed app quits or its audio processes change.
- Improved Process Tap and Aggregate Device lifecycle handling.
- Enhanced compatibility with browser and media-app helper processes.
- Improved real-time audio thread safety and overall stability.

name: MacMix 1.6
body:
## MacMix 1.6 release
- Refactored multi-app mixing to share a single Aggregate Device and IOProc, reducing CPU and memory usage.
- Optimized real-time gain processing for more stable multi-source mixing.
- Improved audio device switching to reduce interruptions, latency, and temporary audio loss.
- Fixed switching-to-Bluetooth noise when multi-mix is on without reducing audio quality.

name: MacMix 1.5
body:
## MacMix 1.5 release
- Added volume and mute control for compatible external monitors using DDC/CI.
- Improved support for displays that don’t provide native macOS volume controls. (Compatibility may vary depending on the display, cable, and dock.)
- Added quick per-app mute controls.

name: MacMix 1.4
body:
## MacMix 1.4 release
- Improved audio device switching.
- Faster, more reliable per-app audio mixing.
- Improved audio app detection.
- Added system mute controls and improved mute status feedback.

name: MacMix 1.3.1
body:
## MacMix 1.3.1 release
- Uses the macOS system default output mechanism for device switching.
- Fixes devices unexpectedly switching back after selecting Bluetooth, USB, or built-in output.
- Fixes freezes and failed device switching during multi-app audio mixing.
- Safely releases the previous audio route before switching and restores mixing once the new device is stable.
- Improves rapid consecutive switching by honoring the latest selected device.
- Adds timeout and recovery handling to prevent prolonged stalls.
- Refines volume transitions to reduce distortion, pops, and abrupt changes.
- Improves multichannel device compatibility and volume control accuracy.
- Enhances overall audio lifecycle management and stability.

name: MacMix 1.3
body:
MacMix 1.3 release
- Add real-time monitoring input and output devices.
- Add quick restore for mix.
- Improve stability.

name: MacMix 1.2
body:
## MacMix 1.2 release
This update improves per-app audio mixing reliability and adds optional volume boost support.

### New

- Added optional per-app volume boost up to 200%.

### Improved

- Improved compatibility with 24-bit audio taps.
- Improved output tap selection for multichannel output devices.
